title: Nightmare Time: Jane's A Car & The Witch in the Web
original_title: Nightmare Time: Jane's A Car & The Witch in the Web
overview: After a year and a half of repairs, widower Tom Houston is reunited with his newly restored 1986 Foxbody Mustang, only to find that the car now carries a ghostly passenger. When Hannah Foster’s dreams are haunted by an evil witch, and her friend, Webby, goes missing, she’ll need the help of a mysterious woman with strange powers to escape her own nightmare time.
